keyVerseDR: "I am the bread of life. He that cometh to me shall not hunger..." (Jn 6:35)

level1.title: Bread of Life
level1.story: The crowd looked for Jesus. They wanted more bread. Jesus said, "I am the Bread of Life!"
level1.keyLine: Jesus is the Bread of Life.
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: How does Jesus feed our hearts?
level1.prayer: Jesus, Bread of Life, feed my heart. Amen.

level2.title: I Am the Bread of Life
level2.story: The crowd got into boats and came to Capernaum looking for Jesus. He said, "You seek Me because you did eat of the loaves." Jesus told them, "Labour not for the meat which perisheth, but for that which endureth unto life everlasting." They asked for a sign, like the manna their fathers ate in the desert. Jesus said, "I am the bread of life: he that cometh to Me shall not hunger."
level2.keyLine: I am the bread of life.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: What does your soul hunger for?
level2.prayer: Jesus, Bread of Life, I believe in You. Amen.
